description: Run JavaScript on the account's computer with bun — no agent turn — and wait for its result. `tools.<namespace>.<function>(args)` calls anything list_integration_tools shows (every call returns its result and throws on failure; top-level await works), and the script's last expression is its result. Chain calls and transform data in one run, e.g. `const { data } = await tools.crevioApi.listOrders({ status: "succeeded" }); data.length`. A function marked requires_approval: true does not run: the call resolves to `{pending: true, draft_id, approval}` (check `result.pending`), the script carries on, and the run lists it in `pending_approval_ids`. Approving it in Crevio, with resolve_approvals, or in the reply when this client can show a form runs that one frozen call, never the script again. Runs as you, and only for account admins. If the wait ends first the reply has wait_timed_out: true and the run id: continue with wait_for_script_run — calling run_script again runs it twice unless you reuse the idempotency_key. Run ids do not expire, and only the user who started a run can read it. At most 4 runs in flight per user. `args` reach the script as the global `args` (and process.argv). Files the script writes into the directory named by the global `outputDir` (20 at most, 50 MB each) come back as `artifacts`; get a download link with get_file_download_url.

args.description: Values the script reads from the global `args`.

idempotency_key.description: Always pass one, unique to this request. Retrying with the same key within an hour returns the run the first call started instead of doing the job twice.

timeout_seconds.description: How long the script may run (default 300).

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the script to finish before returning. Defaults to, and is capped at, 300 s when your client accepts a streamed reply (text/event-stream), 90 s otherwise. The script keeps going when the wait ends first.

name: run_script

outputSchema.description: One script run on the account's computer.

approvals.description: What the script's gated calls froze, as each stands now.

items.description: A gated action, frozen as it was called, and where it stands. Approving runs it once: then `result` or `error` holds the outcome.

reason.description: Why it was denied, or that it expired.

artifacts.description: Files the script wrote to outputDir.

items.description: A file the work produced. Exchange its id for a download link with get_file_download_url.

calls.description: Every tool call the script made, in order.

approval_id.description: Set on a 202: the approval this call is waiting for.

output.description: What the script printed: its start and end when long, with the cut marked.

pending_approval_ids.description: Approvals still waiting for a decision: answer them with resolve_approvals.

result.description: The script's last expression, as JSON.

wait_timed_out.description: The wait ended first. The work is still running: follow it with the tool next_step names.
